faq.q: Is this a full SQL parser?
faq.a: No. It is a lightweight formatter that uppercases common keywords and adds basic newlines. Complex queries may need manual tweaks.

faq.q: Does it send my query to a server?
faq.a: No. Formatting happens entirely in your browser.
It works with standard SQL keywords (SELECT, FROM, WHERE, JOIN, etc.) used by most databases.
